finalText:
All objectives are complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created: reference **RD-1015**, title **"fwrd69-n1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer Bench Test Co, raised 2026-09-17, initial status Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd69-n1 RD Part A"** added with cost $100.00 and markup 25% (qty 1). App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd69-n1 RD Part B"** added with cost $200.00 and markup 25% (qty 1). App-computed price: **$250.00**. Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (row read $150.00 / 25% / $187.50; parts total updated to $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status is **Ready** (verified on the detail page, after a full page reload, and in the ticket list). Precondition discovered: **a ticket must have at least one part before it can be marked Ready.** I confirmed this by creating a scratch probe ticket (RD-1016, "fwrd69-n1 RD Probe", 0 parts) and clicking "Mark Ready" — the app refused with the verbatim alert: *"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"*, and the status stayed Draft. The main ticket RD-1015 already had two parts, so its "Mark Ready" click was accepted immediately with no error. (No other preconditions were enforced — no confirmation dialog or other validation appeared.)

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted via each row's Delete action, confirming the dialogs *"Delete the part "fwrd69-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."* (and the same for Part B). Parts table afterwards shows 0 rows / "No parts on this ticket yet." (the app drops the total row entirely rather than showing $0.00). The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog; button changed to "Unarchive ticket", detail page shows an "Archived" badge, status still Ready). Verified in the ticket list with search "fwrd69-n1" and "Show archived" unchecked: **"No tickets match the current filters."** — nothing from this run remains active. With "Show archived" checked, only two archived rows remain: RD-1015 (Ready, 0 parts) and the RD-1016 probe (Draft, 0 parts), which I also archived as cleanup since the UI offers no ticket-delete action.
